name: Autodesk

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org - Wikipedia infobox logo file: Autodesk Logo 2021.svg

description: Autodesk sells design and engineering software to architects, engineers, builders, manufacturers and media studios: AutoCAD, Revit and Civil 3D for buildings and infrastructure, Inventor and Fusion for product design, Maya and 3ds Max for film and games, and Autodesk Construction Cloud (now Forma for Construction) for building sites. Nearly all revenue is subscription: term subscriptions, cloud services and enterprise business agreements (token-based access to a pool of products). It reports one segment and splits revenue into a Design business (core desktop-plus-cloud products) and a Make business (cloud-only construction and manufacturing tools). Autodesk has restructured its sales organisation over FY2026.

gics.note: Conventional label as listed in the Wikipedia 'List of S&P 500 companies' table (GICS sector and GICS sub-industry columns). That table does not give the industry group or industry levels, so they are null rather than filled from memory.

hq.note: Cover of FY2026 10-K: San Francisco, CA 94105; Delaware corporation

employees.note: Down from about 15,300 a year earlier (FY2026 10-K)

businessLines.name: Design
businessLines.how: Annual or multi-year term subscriptions per user (named-user model) and enterprise agreements where large customers draw on a token pool; recognised ratably over the term.
businessLines.description: Maintenance, product subscriptions and all enterprise business agreements; AutoCAD, AutoCAD LT, Industry Collections, Revit, Inventor, Maya, 3ds Max.

businessLines.name: Make
businessLines.how: Cloud subscriptions priced per project, user or usage (construction and manufacturing customers), billed annually or upfront.
businessLines.description: Cloud-based subscriptions: Autodesk Build, BIM Collaborate Pro, BuildingConnected, Fusion, Flow Production Tracking.

businessLines.name: Other
businessLines.how: Fees for consulting and training recognised as services are delivered.
businessLines.description: Consulting, training and other products and services.
